content.en: Synthetic training fixture: A 46-year-old adult arrives at urgent care after two days of cough, chills, and poor sleep. The triage nurse documents temperature 38.1 °C, HR 104 bpm, blood pressure 118/76 mmHg, RR 20/min, and SpO2 96% on room air. The client speaks in full sentences but pauses to cough. Lung sounds are coarse at the right base without wheezing. Mucous membranes are slightly dry. The provider orders oral fluids and a chest radiograph. Point-of-care glucose is 132 mg/dL because the client reports missing breakfast before taking morning diabetes medication. No earlier vitals are included in the note.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：一名46岁成人因咳嗽、寒战和睡眠差两天到急诊护理中心就诊。分诊护士记录体温38.1 °C，HR 104 bpm，blood pressure 118/76 mmHg，RR 20/min，SpO2 96%（室内空气）。患者能完整说话，但会停下来咳嗽。右肺底可闻及粗糙呼吸音，无哮鸣音。黏膜稍干。医嘱给予口服补液并拍胸片。因患者早餐前已服糖尿病药但未进食，床旁glucose为132 mg/dL。记录中未包含更早的生命体征。

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: Six hours after laparoscopic cholecystectomy, the nurse completes a focused surgical check. The client is awake, oriented, and using the incentive spirometer with coaching. Heart rate is 86 bpm, BP 126/70 mm Hg, respiratory rate 18/min, SpO₂ 98% on 2 L nasal cannula, and T 36.8 °C. The abdomen is soft with expected incisional tenderness. Four small dressings are dry and intact. The latest basic metabolic panel shows sodium 139 mEq/L, potassium 4.0 mEq/L, and creatinine 0.8 mg/dL. The client tolerates ice chips and denies nausea. No baseline or trend values are stated.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：腹腔镜胆囊切除术后6小时，护士完成重点外科复查。患者清醒、定向力正常，并在指导下使用激励式肺量计。heart rate为86 bpm，BP 126/70 mm Hg，respiratory rate 18/min，SpO₂ 98%（2 L鼻导管吸氧），T 36.8 °C。腹部柔软，切口疼痛符合预期。四处小敷料干燥完整。最新基础代谢检查显示sodium 139 mEq/L，potassium 4.0 mEq/L，creatinine 0.8 mg/dL。患者能耐受冰屑且否认恶心。记录中未说明基线或趋势值。

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: During a same-day clinic recheck for urinary symptoms, the nurse notes that the client is uncomfortable but not toxic appearing. Temperature is 37.6 °C, pulse 92 bpm, blood pressure 110/68 mmHg, RR 16/min, and oxygen saturation 99% on room air. The client reports burning with urination and mild suprapubic pressure. Urinalysis is pending. The metabolic panel obtained this morning lists BUN 16 mg/dL, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, sodium 136 mEq/L, and bicarbonate 24 mEq/L. The provider reviews hydration instructions and plans oral antibiotics if the urine culture supports infection.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：因泌尿症状进行当日门诊复查时，护士记录患者不适但无中毒貌。Temperature 37.6 °C，pulse 92 bpm，blood pressure 110/68 mmHg，RR 16/min，oxygen saturation 99%（室内空气）。患者诉排尿灼痛和轻度耻骨上压迫感。尿检待出。今晨代谢面板列出BUN 16 mg/dL，creatinine 0.7 mg/dL，sodium 136 mEq/L，bicarbonate 24 mEq/L。医护人员复习补水指导，并计划在尿培养支持感染时给予口服抗生素。

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: The nurse reassesses a client being treated for vomiting after a viral illness. Current vital signs are BP 102/64 mmHg, HR 108 bpm, RR 19/min, temperature 37.4 °C, and SpO2 97% on room air. The blood pressure was 118/72 mmHg at the clinic visit yesterday, and the heart rate was 82 bpm before the vomiting worsened. Mucous membranes remain dry, but the client is able to sip oral rehydration solution. The afternoon chemistry panel shows sodium 146 mEq/L, potassium 3.3 mEq/L, BUN 28 mg/dL, and creatinine 1.2 mg/dL; creatinine was 0.8 mg/dL on last month’s routine labs.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：护士复评一名病毒感染后呕吐正在治疗的患者。当前生命体征为BP 102/64 mmHg，HR 108 bpm，RR 19/min，temperature 37.4 °C，SpO2 97%（室内空气）。昨日门诊时blood pressure was 118/72 mmHg，呕吐加重前heart rate was 82 bpm。黏膜仍干，但患者能小口饮用口服补液液。下午化学面板显示sodium 146 mEq/L，potassium 3.3 mEq/L，BUN 28 mg/dL，creatinine 1.2 mg/dL；上月常规化验creatinine was 0.8 mg/dL。

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: A client in the observation unit reports dizziness when standing after a heavy menstrual period. The nurse documents current T 36.7 °C, heart rate 98 bpm, BP 104/66 mm Hg, RR 17/min, and SpO₂ 100% on room air. Skin is warm and pale. The client denies chest pain or shortness of breath at rest. Current labs show hemoglobin 8.9 g/dL and hematocrit 27%. Hemoglobin was 11.4 g/dL at a primary care visit three months ago. Potassium is 3.8 mEq/L and glucose is 118 mg/dL. The provider discusses iron therapy and return precautions.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：观察病区一名患者在月经过多后站立时感头晕。护士记录当前T 36.7 °C，heart rate 98 bpm，BP 104/66 mm Hg，RR 17/min，SpO₂ 100%（室内空气）。皮肤温暖但苍白。患者否认静息时胸痛或气短。当前化验显示hemoglobin 8.9 g/dL，hematocrit 27%。三个月前基层门诊hemoglobin was 11.4 g/dL。Potassium为3.8 mEq/L，glucose为118 mg/dL。医护人员讨论铁剂治疗和返院警示。

title.zh: 合成蜂窝织炎复评记录

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: On the medical unit, a client with cellulitis is reassessed after the first dose of IV antibiotics. Temperature is 38.4 °C, HR 112 bpm, blood pressure 116/74 mmHg, RR 21/min, and SpO2 95% on room air. The right lower leg is red, warm, and tender but pulses are palpable. The CBC resulted during the assessment: WBC 12.4 × 10³/µL, hemoglobin 13.1 g/dL, and platelets 145,000/µL. The chemistry panel lists sodium 137 mEq/L, potassium 4.2 mEq/L, and creatinine 0.9 mg/dL. The provider asks the nurse to outline the erythema and continue monitoring.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：内科病区一名蜂窝织炎患者在第一剂静脉抗生素后接受复评。Temperature 38.4 °C，HR 112 bpm，blood pressure 116/74 mmHg，RR 21/min，SpO2 95%（室内空气）。右小腿发红、发热、压痛，但脉搏可触及。评估期间CBC出结果：WBC 12.4 × 10³/µL，hemoglobin 13.1 g/dL，platelets 145,000/µL。化学面板列出sodium 137 mEq/L，potassium 4.2 mEq/L，creatinine 0.9 mg/dL。医护人员要求护士标记红斑边界并继续监测。

title.zh: 合成肿瘤门诊电话评估记录

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: A client receiving chemotherapy calls the oncology clinic for new bruising. During nurse assessment, pulse is 90 bpm, BP 122/78 mmHg, RR 16/min, T 37.0 °C, and SpO₂ 99% on room air. The client has scattered ecchymoses on both forearms and denies nosebleeds, black stools, or headache. Today’s CBC reports WBC 4.8 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 10.2 g/dL, hematocrit 31%, and platelets 88,000/µL. The metabolic panel shows creatinine 0.8 mg/dL and sodium 140 mEq/L. The nurse reinforces bleeding precautions and routes the result to the oncology provider.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：一名接受化疗的患者因新发瘀斑致电肿瘤门诊。护士评估时，pulse 90 bpm，BP 122/78 mmHg，RR 16/min，T 37.0 °C，SpO₂ 99%（室内空气）。患者双前臂散在瘀斑，否认鼻出血、黑便或头痛。今日CBC报告WBC 4.8 ×10³/µL，hemoglobin 10.2 g/dL，hematocrit 31%，platelets 88,000/µL。代谢面板显示creatinine 0.8 mg/dL，sodium 140 mEq/L。护士强化出血预防并将结果转给肿瘤科医护人员。

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: In the short-stay unit, a client is observed after receiving IV contrast for abdominal imaging. Morning assessment is calm, with BP 128/76 mmHg, HR 84 bpm, RR 15/min, temperature 36.9 °C, and SpO2 98% on room air. The nurse highlights the renal trend in the handoff: creatinine was 0.9 mg/dL at 0600 and creatinine is 1.3 mg/dL at 1400. Urine is clear yellow, and the client denies flank pain. Sodium is 138 mEq/L and potassium is 4.1 mEq/L on the later panel. The provider encourages oral fluids and asks for continued intake and output monitoring through the evening.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：短期留观病区一名患者在腹部影像使用静脉造影剂后接受观察。晨间评估平稳，BP 128/76 mmHg，HR 84 bpm，RR 15/min，temperature 36.9 °C，SpO2 98%（室内空气）。护士在交班中强调肾功能趋势：creatinine was 0.9 mg/dL at 0600，creatinine is 1.3 mg/dL at 1400。尿液清亮黄色，患者否认腰痛。较晚面板显示sodium 138 mEq/L，potassium 4.1 mEq/L。医护人员鼓励口服补液，并要求晚间继续监测摄入和排出。

title.zh: 合成病毒样症状复评记录

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: A pediatric-capable urgent care nurse writes a reassessment note for an adult client with influenza-like illness. The client received oral fluids and acetaminophen while waiting. Temperature was 39.0 °C at 1015, and temperature is 38.2 °C at 1130. The current pulse is 106 bpm, blood pressure 112/70 mmHg, RR 20/min, and SpO₂ 97% on room air. The client reports less aching but still feels chilled. Glucose is 126 mg/dL from a fingerstick done because the client has diabetes. The provider reviews isolation instructions and advises the client to return for worsening breathing or confusion.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：具备儿科能力的急诊护理中心护士为一名流感样症状成人患者书写复评记录。患者等待期间接受口服补液和对乙酰氨基酚。Temperature was 39.0 °C at 1015，temperature is 38.2 °C at 1130。当前pulse 106 bpm，blood pressure 112/70 mmHg，RR 20/min，SpO₂ 97%（室内空气）。患者诉酸痛减轻但仍发冷。因患者有糖尿病，指尖glucose为126 mg/dL。医护人员复习隔离指导，并建议患者若呼吸加重或意识混乱需返诊。

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: The labor and delivery nurse documents a focused reassessment for a postpartum client with severe headache and visual spots. The client is awake and anxious, with RR 18/min, SpO2 96% on room air, heart rate 88 bpm, and temperature 37.2 °C. Patellar reflexes are brisk but there is no clonus. Urine is concentrated in the collection container. Blood pressure after IV labetalol: 150/92 mm Hg. The note contains no earlier blood pressure number. The provider is notified that symptoms persist and asks the nurse to continue seizure precautions while preparing the next ordered medication.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：产科护士为一名产后剧烈头痛并有视物斑点的患者记录重点复评。患者清醒但焦虑，RR 18/min，SpO2 96%（室内空气），heart rate 88 bpm，temperature 37.2 °C。髌腱反射亢进但无阵挛。收集容器内尿液浓缩。Blood pressure after IV labetalol: 150/92 mm Hg。记录中没有更早的血压数值。医护人员获知症状持续，并要求护士继续癫痫预防措施，同时准备下一项医嘱药物。

title.zh: 合成肾功能化验复核记录

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: A client with chronic kidney disease is reviewed in the ED for weakness after several days of poor intake. Current vital signs are HR 96 bpm, BP 134/82 mmHg, RR 18/min, SpO2 98% on room air, and temperature 37.1 °C. The nurse notes dry lips and slow position changes. The chemistry report includes sodium 132 mEq/L, potassium 5.2 mEq/L, BUN 42 mg/dL, creatinine 2.1 mg/dL, and glucose 154 mg/dL. The same printout also lists lithium 1.4 mEq/L, eGFR 31 mL/min/1.73 m², albumin 3.0 g/dL, CRP 9.8 mg/dL, osmolality 304 mOsm/kg, alkaline phosphatase 180 U/L, and weight 71 kg. The provider reviews medication adherence and asks for a repeat chemistry panel after fluids.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：一名慢性肾病患者因数日进食差后乏力到急诊复核。当前生命体征为HR 96 bpm，BP 134/82 mmHg，RR 18/min，SpO2 98%（室内空气），temperature 37.1 °C。护士记录嘴唇干燥，体位改变缓慢。化学报告包括sodium 132 mEq/L，potassium 5.2 mEq/L，BUN 42 mg/dL，creatinine 2.1 mg/dL，glucose 154 mg/dL。同一报告还列出lithium 1.4 mEq/L，eGFR 31 mL/min/1.73 m²，albumin 3.0 g/dL，CRP 9.8 mg/dL，osmolality 304 mOsm/kg，alkaline phosphatase 180 U/L，weight 71 kg。医护人员复核用药依从性，并要求补液后复查化学面板。

content.en: Synthetic training fixture: A medical-surgical nurse receives a client with suspected pneumonia and mild confusion. Current assessment shows temperature 38.3 °C, pulse 118 bpm, blood pressure 104/60 mmHg, RR 24/min, and SpO₂ 92% on 2 L nasal cannula. The blood pressure was 128/78 mmHg at an outside clinic earlier today, and creatinine was 0.9 mg/dL on last year’s wellness labs. Current labs show WBC 18.6 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 11.6 g/dL, platelets 52,000/µL, sodium 134 mEq/L, potassium 3.6 mEq/L, BUN 30 mg/dL, creatinine 1.4 mg/dL, and lactate 2.6 mmol/L. The outside record also lists albumin 2.8 g/dL and eGFR 46 mL/min/1.73 m². The nurse starts fall precautions and notifies the provider of worsening oxygen need.
content.zh: 合成训练用病例：内外科护士接收一名疑似肺炎并轻度意识混乱的患者。当前评估显示temperature 38.3 °C，pulse 118 bpm，blood pressure 104/60 mmHg，RR 24/min，SpO₂ 92%（2 L鼻导管吸氧）。今日早些时候外部门诊blood pressure was 128/78 mmHg，去年体检creatinine was 0.9 mg/dL。当前化验显示WBC 18.6 ×10³/µL，hemoglobin 11.6 g/dL，platelets 52,000/µL，sodium 134 mEq/L，potassium 3.6 mEq/L，BUN 30 mg/dL，creatinine 1.4 mg/dL，lactate 2.6 mmol/L。外部记录还列出albumin 2.8 g/dL和eGFR 46 mL/min/1.73 m²。护士启动跌倒预防并通知医护人员氧气需求加重。
